title: Report a partially applied VCF Operations for Networks syslog rollout accurately
prompt: Implement src/vcfon_syslog/client.py and src/vcfon_syslog/rollout.py in this stdlib-only Python package, which pushes an operator's syslog forwarding plan to a VCF Operations for Networks 9.1 appliance. Both files are stubs today; transport.py, plan.py and errors.py are already written and should be used as they are. docs/contract.json is the local REST contract for the six operations involved (create, getSyslogTargetList, addSyslogTarget, updateSyslogTarget, sendSyslogTestMessage, delete) and docs/official_sources.json records its provenance; the contract is authoritative for method, path, payload shape and success status. README.md states the required run order and the exact report dict that apply_syslog_plan must return. Applying a plan is not transactional: read the appliance's current targets first to decide add versus update for every plan target, then apply them in plan order, and when one comes back non-2xx stop there. Targets already applied stay applied and must be reported as such with the HTTP status and the ApiError code and message of the one that failed; the targets after it are reported skipped and never sent. Then send a test log for each target that was actually applied, in plan order, and record the boolean StatusResponse.status as the verified flag -- an HTTP 200 whose status is false means the target is applied but the test log did not get through. Release the auth token at the end whether or not the rollout failed. Encode requests exactly as the contract specifies: port is a JSON number, the Authorization header is 'NetworkInsight {token}' on every operation except create, which must send none, and an optional field the operator did not set must be absent from the JSON object rather than sent as null, an empty string, zero or an empty object -- that covers nick_name and collector_id on a syslog target, value inside a Domain, and the domain object itself. Run python3 tests/verify.py. Only src/vcfon_syslog/client.py and src/vcfon_syslog/rollout.py are implementation files; docs/, fixtures/, tests/ and the other modules under src/vcfon_syslog/ are protected fixtures and must not be changed.
